name: cineweave-studio
description: CineWeave Studio is a composable creative Skill system for independent story, character, scene, style, direction, prompt and production workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Composable creative workflows for images, video and production design.
interface.longDescription: CineWeave Studio v2.2 provides an optional $cineweave entry point plus seven independently usable specialist Skills. Story owns causality, script scenes and continuity; Character owns identity and performance; Scene owns geography, physical interaction and physical light state; Style owns visual and temporal representation; Director owns blocking, camera, shot lighting and time; Prompt owns reusable text-to-image assets across cinematic and non-cinematic domains; Production owns recipes, controls, evidence, capability, rights and evaluation. Exact versioned contracts support direct specialist use and acyclic composition without hidden state. A deterministic local runtime stores immutable artifacts, binds approvals to hashes and assembles multi-panel boards outside image models.
defaultPrompt: Turn my vague visual idea into an editable creative brief.
Explore an original character from a feeling, then let me choose.
Develop this premise into causal beats and a playable script scene.
Write an observable Chinese image prompt for this portrait, product or scene.
